verdict.rationale: The marketing claim that "Summer builds it with you" from a description suggests the engine provides its own AI that generates game content. Most of the remaining evidence describes bring-your-own external agents (Claude Code, Codex) connected through Summer's MCP server, including docs-search tools for answering API questions, rather than a documented built-in assistant. missing for 10: explicit documentation of an official in-engine assistant UI, specific evidence of script generation and scene/asset scaffolding by that assistant, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an official AI assistant inside the engine helps with engine tasks — generating scripts, answering API questions, scaffolding scenes or assets

citations.quote: Describe the game you want and Summer builds it with you in a full engine: 2D and 3D, physics, animation and real gameplay.
The MCP server ships summer\_docs\_search and summer\_docs\_read, so the model can pull Summer guidance in-chat.
